name: un_get_sdg_data
description:
Time series of one SDG indicator, for one area or all, from the UN Statistics Division SDG API (Indicator/Data, no API key).
Returns: indicator_code, indicator_description (the series description), country_code, country_name, data (year, value, unit per observation) and count; on failure an error and note instead.
Inputs (* required): indicator_code* (SDG indicator code such as 1.1.1 or 3.2.1); country_code (area code passed to the API as areaCode; the schema suggests ISO3; omit for all areas); start_year and end_year (2000-2030; each optional).
Find indicator codes with un_get_sdg_indicators. For World Bank development series use wb_get_country_data.
Example: {"indicator_code": "3.2.1", "country_code": "IND", "start_year": 2015, "end_year": 2023}

indicator_code.description: SDG indicator code (e.g., '1.1.1' for poverty headcount ratio, '3.2.1' for under-5 mortality rate)

country_code.description: ISO3 country code (e.g., 'USA', 'CHN', 'IND'). Optional - omit for global/all countries data.

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Retrieves actual measurement data for SDG indicators. Data availability varies by country and indicator. Some indicators are updated annually, others less frequently.

examples.description: Get poverty rate data for India (indicator 1.1.1)
Get recent maternal mortality data for Brazil

useCases: Track country progress on specific SDG indicators
